time_patch_contract.load_policy: Only pinned corrected hashes and explicit research source type may be loaded. Original hashes, unknown hashes, duplicate correction, missing or non-null corrected fields are rejected. Reported time is never a verified time.

historical_runner_contract.rule: Keep evidence_id unchanged; suffix is target number only. Never use target number to bind historical incident. Require race, source hash and same row native ID. Person registration validity remains unknown.

peer_chronology.relation_rule: Same horse/race root may serve multiple hypotheses, never independent duplicate support. AFTER_DATE_ONLY does not prove verified prestart publication or comparative condition. Earlier race and same event not later evidence. Same day missing timestamp blocked.
